title: senecio solandri
intro: Senecio solandri, commonly known as Buttercup Bush, is a flowering plant native to New Zealand and Australia. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its various health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and promoting relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Senecio solandri are attributed to its sedative and antispasmodic properties, helping to alleviate anxiety, insomnia, and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of Senecio solandri include sesquiterpene lactones, which have been shown to have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties.
